title: Advanced Custom Event Bus Subscriber Configuration
description: Create three EventBridge custom event bus subscribers, each using more features: filter, then retry and dead-letter queue, then a JSONata transform.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A subscriber on an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus delivers matching events to a target, and can filter, retry, dead-letter, and transform along the way. This snippet creates three subscribers, each using more of those features than the last, so you can see what each one adds.
Subscriber 1 filters only. Subscriber 2 adds a retry policy and a dead-letter queue for delivery resilience. Subscriber 3 adds a JSONata transform that reshapes the payload before delivery.

The three subscribers use different comparison operators in their filters, and a final block lists more reusable filter values you can swap in. The target, delivery role, and dead-letter queue must belong to the account creating the subscriber.

codeTabs.title: AWS CLI
codeTabs.description: Replace the placeholders with your own ARNs. The most basic subscriber: a DATA-scoped filter that delivers only events whose detail.status equals PLACED, and drops everything else.

codeTabs.title: AWS SAM
codeTabs.description: Deploy with `sam deploy --template-file subscriber1-filter-sam.yaml --stack-name orders-basic-sam --region <EVENT_BUS_REGION> --parameter-overrides EventBusArn=<EVENT_BUS_ARN> TargetArn=<TARGET_QUEUE_ARN> RoleArn=<DELIVERY_ROLE_ARN> --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset`.

codeTabs.title: AWS CLI
codeTabs.description: A more resilient subscriber. Adds --retry-policy to retry failed deliveries and --on-failure-configuration to send events that exhaust their retries to an SQS dead-letter queue. Uses a numeric-range filter.

codeTabs.title: AWS SAM
codeTabs.description: Deploy with `sam deploy --template-file subscriber2-filter-retry-dlq-sam.yaml --stack-name orders-resilient-sam --region <EVENT_BUS_REGION> --parameter-overrides EventBusArn=<EVENT_BUS_ARN> TargetArn=<TARGET_QUEUE_ARN> RoleArn=<DELIVERY_ROLE_ARN> DeadLetterQueueArn=<DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_ARN> --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset`.

snippets.title: Subscriber 3: Filter + retry + dead-letter queue + JSONata transform

codeTabs.title: AWS CLI
codeTabs.description: The fully featured subscriber. Adds --transformer with Type JSONATA to reshape the payload before delivery, on top of the filter, retry, and dead-letter queue. Uses an $or filter across fields.

codeTabs.title: AWS SAM
codeTabs.description: Deploy with `sam deploy --template-file subscriber3-filter-retry-dlq-transform-sam.yaml --stack-name orders-full-sam --region <EVENT_BUS_REGION> --parameter-overrides EventBusArn=<EVENT_BUS_ARN> TargetArn=<TARGET_QUEUE_ARN> RoleArn=<DELIVERY_ROLE_ARN> DeadLetterQueueArn=<DEAD_LETTER_QUEUE_ARN> --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset`.

snippets.title: Filtering with comparison operators
snippets.description: Five DATA-scoped filter values using EventBridge comparison operators: numeric range, anything-but, begins-with (prefix), exists, and $or across fields. Swap any one into the --filter-configuration of a subscriber above.
